storage_only_registers.rule: All fixed and bank-expanded storage-only addresses are enumerated, and every normative function that can reach the extended register backing store or any generic/context address API is content-addressed. A literal full-bank address, computed index, symbolic helper call, or direct backing-store access changes the reviewed inventory and fails closed.

envelope_only_traps.rule: Envelope-only fault symbols remain limited to declaration and SetFault mapping. Every normative function that can mutate trap identity, invoke a trap producer, or mention canonical trap numbers 33, 49, or 51 is content-addressed, so direct assignments, helper activation, and indirect SetFault call sites fail closed.
